newsitem.title: USA: Mutual fund assets rose in latest week - ICI.
newsitem.headline: Mutual fund assets rose in latest week - ICI.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets rose to $991.64 billion for the week ended July 23 from a revised $984.48 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 670 retail money market mutual funds rose $3.11 billion to $656.35 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 404 taxable money market funds rose $3.23 billion to $538.30 billion, while assets of the 266 tax-exempt funds fell $117.0 million to $118.05 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 325 institutional money market funds rose $4.05 billion to $335.29 billion. Of these, assets of the 262 taxable money market funds rose $3.99 billion to $300.19 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds were up $62.7 million to $35.10 billion, it said.
ICI revised total money market mutual fund assets for the previous week to $984.48 billion from $984.46 billion.
